description: Geology, flooring, ancient landmarks, civil-rights history, zoology, ceremonial music and Fleet Street give this compact run an unusually varied path through science, culture, language and British history.

s05e01.description: Igneous rock gives geology its turn under the studio lights. Earth science anchors a ladder of mixed knowledge where apparently solid facts can become surprisingly molten the moment four plausible alternatives are placed beside them.

s05e02.description: Parquet flooring becomes the episode’s beautifully ordinary piece of specialist vocabulary. Design, objects and general knowledge collide, proving once again that the most dangerous Millionaire questions are often about things people have walked over for years.

s05e03.description: The Pharos of Alexandria lights up the episode with one of antiquity’s great landmarks. Ancient history stands tall among a roaming set of questions, even if the path to the correct answer is considerably less well illuminated.

s05e04.description: One of history’s most recognisable phrases becomes the episode’s cultural landmark. Politics, history and general knowledge converge around ‘I Have a Dream’, while the ladder tests whether familiarity with famous words extends to the facts surrounding them.

s05e05.description: A toothed whale swims into the question set as the episode’s natural-history oddity. Classification becomes unexpectedly consequential, and the ladder demonstrates that knowing an animal exists is merely the beginner level of quiz zoology.

s05e06.description: The Bridal Chorus gives the festive episode an unexpectedly matrimonial soundtrack. Music and ceremony join the usual knowledge mixture, with a tune almost everyone can recognise becoming much more interesting once recognition is no longer enough.

s05e07.description: Fleet Street brings newspapers, London history and cultural shorthand into the hot seat. The episode moves through a broad range of knowledge while one famous street demonstrates how geography can become an entire profession’s nickname.
